title: Split reindexing of bar totals
statement: Let D and E be diagrams of integer cochain complexes on small preorders I and J, and let f:I -> J be an injective order map [def-sc-preorder-bar-total]. If a natural transformation D -> E(f(-)) is split monic in each term, its induced map of bar totals is split monic in each term.

source.place: The source-bar, finite-cone-block, least-block adjunction and union-bar paragraphs; Split reindexing of bar totals.

proof.text: An injective order map induces an injective map on monotone strings. On a coproduct indexed by strings define a retraction using the chosen termwise retraction on a string in the image and zero off the image. Coproduct extensionality verifies the left inverse. Conjugate this retraction by the evaluation-coproduct isomorphisms in each column, then use totalDesc on diagonal components. The component identities give the left inverse in each total degree.

theorem totalMap_split
    (D : I ⥤ CochainComplex C ℤ) (E : J ⥤ CochainComplex C ℤ)
    (f : I →o J) (hf : Function.Injective f) (φ : D ⟶ orderFunctor f ⋙ E)
    (hφ : ∀ (i : I) (q : ℤ), IsSplitMono ((φ.app i).f q)) (n : ℤ) :
    IsSplitMono ((totalMap D E f φ).f n)
